title: A little change is good
body: You may notice things are changing a bit around here. Take a look around. We are trying to focus on our core mission of appreciating nature: signs on the plants, displays in our air conditioned spaces, interesting facts about all the species here. More to come, so stay tuned!

title: Please consider becoming a member
body: Members keep the gates open and the gardens growing. Annual membership starts at the office — it takes about two minutes.
link_text: Stop by the office on your way out

title: Take a plant home
body: The nursery is open Tuesdays and Saturdays. They propagate plants from the park and sell donated plants from our community friends. Every plant sold goes straight back into the park.
link_text: Nursery is open by the office

title: You could get married here
body: The Galleria and the deck host weddings, showers, memorials and company dinners — surrounded by ten acres of garden.
link_text: Ask about dates at the office

title: The Galleria is available
body: The Galleria seats a crowd for classes, meetings, dinners and celebrations. New tables and chairs, thanks to the Selby Foundation.

title: Scan the plants signs
body: New signs are going up across the park this month. Point your phone camera at the code and a world of information about each opens up for you.
link_text: Look for them on the metal posts

title: Your photos could end up on these walls
body: Every plant and animal photo on our website came from a visitor, a volunteer or a student with a phone. Post an observation to iNaturalist at Palma Sola and it may end up in the catalog — credited to you.
link_text: Ask us how to get started

title: Thank you, Selby Foundation
body: Every class, wedding and community dinner in the Galleria now starts on new tables and chairs — a $20,000 gift from the William G. & Marie Selby Foundation.

title: Thank you, Bishop Parker Foundation
body: The gathering deck was rebuilt in lasting composite — good for many years of weddings, classes and pond-watching.
